adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In 2014, Ebony Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and shows him his own future. Maw follows his father to 2023, fights for him at the ruined Avengers Compound and turns to dust with him in Tony Stark's snap.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Maw's adoptive father. Maw uncovers his future for him and dies with him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Adopted son who searches Nebula's memories for him. Turns to dust with him.
adds.evidence: Endgame: the 2014 Maw examines the captured Nebula for Thanos ('Sire, the file appears entangled... another Nebula'), plays her memories of Thanos' future and death, then follows him to 2023, alerts him that Barton has the gauntlet, and is dusted by Stark's snap. These are the 2014 versions of both, as the app already does for the 2014 Gamora.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Nebula has stayed in touch with this Gamora, now a Ravager, and brings her in to help the Guardians save Rocket. They fight side by side, then Gamora goes back to the Ravagers while Nebula stays on Knowhere.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Sister who keeps in touch and brings Gamora in to save Rocket.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Gamora now with the Ravagers, who helps Nebula save Rocket.
adds.evidence: Vol. 3: Nebula had kept in contact with the 2014 Gamora (Quill asks why she didn't tell him); Gamora joins the Orgoscope and Counter-Earth missions with the Guardians; at the end Gamora rejoins the Ravagers and Nebula stays on Knowhere to raise the children.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Back after five years as dust, Groot reunites with Rocket in the battle against Thanos, and Rocket shields him when a turret opens fire on them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Surrogate father, who shields Groot in battle after his return.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The young Groot, back from the dust, whom Rocket shields in battle.
adds.evidence: Endgame, Battle of Earth: Groot is restored, reunites with Rocket on the battlefield; when Groot is knocked back by a blast Rocket tries to shield him from a turret targeting them.

adds.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
adds.text: On Indigarr, Rocket scolds Groot for getting sap all over his binoculars.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Surrogate father, who scolds Groot over sap on his binoculars.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The growing Groot, who gets sap on Rocket's binoculars.
adds.evidence: Love and Thunder, Battle of Indigarr: Groot and Rocket fight over Rocket's binoculars ('No, give me that.' 'I am Groot.' 'Oh, you got sap all over it.').

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: After the Christmas party on Knowhere, Rocket and Cosmo decorate Groot like a Christmas tree until his arms get tired and the ornaments fall.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Surrogate father, who decorates Groot like a Christmas tree.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A grown Groot, who stands as Rocket's Christmas tree.
adds.evidence: Holiday Special: after the celebrations Rocket has Groot stand like a Christmas tree while he and Cosmo decorate him; Groot lowers his arms and decorations fall (end tag scene; tag scenes belong to their title).

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Groot sits by the dying Rocket and fights through Counter-Earth for the code that saves him, then hugs him when he wakes. When Rocket becomes captain, Groot stays on his team and they dance together on Knowhere.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Surrogate father, whose life Groot helps save. Groot stays on his team.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A grown Groot, who helps save Rocket's life and joins his team.
adds.evidence: Vol. 3: Groot sits by Rocket's side en route to the Orgoscope, retrieves Theel's passkey with Quill on Counter-Earth and hugs the revived Rocket; at the end Groot is in Rocket's new Guardians lineup and the two dance to 'Dog Days Are Over'.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
adds.text: Hope and her father work side by side to build a quantum tunnel and find Janet, and the FBI arrests them together. Hope holds off Ava while Hank goes into the Quantum Realm and brings her mother home.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daughter and partner in the hunt to rescue Janet.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Father who works with Hope to bring her mother home.
adds.evidence: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Hank and Hope open a tunnel to the Quantum Realm, kidnap Lang, are arrested together by the FBI; Lang and Hope distract Ava while Pym enters the Quantum Realm and retrieves Janet.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
adds.text: Pulled into the Quantum Realm, Hope and her father press Janet together for the truth about Kang. Hank later returns with his ants to help Hope fight Kang.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Daughter, trapped in the Quantum Realm alongside Hank.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Father, who fights beside Hope against Kang.
adds.evidence: Quantumania: Hope, Hank and Janet land together in the Quantum Realm and question Janet; after Hank is rescued by his ants he helps Scott and Hope make their way to Kang and arrives with the ants in the battle.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
adds.text: Pulled back into the Quantum Realm, Janet finally tells Hank about her past with Kang. They fight to stop Kang and escape home together through her portal.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Wife, who finally tells Hank the truth about Kang.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Husband, who learns her secrets and helps stop Kang.
adds.evidence: Quantumania: aboard Krylar's ship Janet confesses to Hope and Hank that she met Kang; after the battle Janet fixes the power core and she and Hank go through the portal home.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
adds.text: In the Quantum Realm, Hope confronts her mother for keeping secrets. When Janet tells her about Kang, Hope comforts her and promises they will stop him together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mother, whose secrets about Kang Hope finally hears.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Daughter, who comforts Janet and vows to stop Kang with her.
adds.evidence: Quantumania: Hope repeatedly challenges Janet ('Then make me trust you!'); after Janet tells her about Kang, Hope says 'you are not alone now. We'll stop him together.'

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Back after five years as dust, Hope reunites with Scott in the battle against Thanos and carries him to the van to start the quantum tunnel. They stand together at Tony Stark's funeral.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Partner, reunited with Hope in the battle against Thanos.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Partner, back from the dust, who carries Scott to the van in battle.
adds.evidence: Endgame: Hope arrives through a portal, meets Lang when Rogers tells them to get the tunnel started ('We're on it, Cap'), shrinks and carries Lang to Luis' van; she and Lang attend Stark's funeral with Hank and Janet.

adds.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
adds.text: In the Quantum Realm, Hope pulls Scott out of a probability storm, then comes back through the portal to save him from Kang. Together they throw Kang into his power core, and they say they love each other.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Partner whom Hope saves twice in the Quantum Realm.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Partner who comes back to save Scott from Kang.
adds.evidence: Quantumania: Hope arrives in the power core and helps Scott through the probability storm; she returns through the portal when Kang attacks Scott, and they throw Kang into the core; afterward they exchange 'I love you'.

owner_calls.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
owner_calls.question: Korg's opening recap shows Frigga with baby Thor (new footage) and archive shots of her from earlier films. Is that enough for a stage, or is a recap of earlier events not a new stage?
options: No stage: a recap of earlier titles adds nothing new between them
Add a family stage: 'In Korg's telling of Thor's life, Frigga holds Thor as a baby.'
owner_calls.evidence: Love and Thunder lists Frigga in flashbacks only: a young Frigga (new actress) with baby Thor in the recap, plus archive footage. No new event between them.

owner_calls.title: Captain America: Civil War
owner_calls.question: Howard appears in two ways: Tony's BARF simulation of his last night with his parents in 1991 (a recreated real memory, where Tony regrets his last words to his father), and Zemo's footage of Bucky killing Howard, which turns Tony against Steve and Bucky. Does either count as a stage between Howard and Tony, given 'visions and illusions are not events, real flashbacks are'?
options: Add a family stage: 'Tony relives his last goodbye to his father through a memory simulation, then learns from old footage that Bucky Barnes killed him.'
No stage: the simulation is an illusion and the footage is between Bucky and Howard
owner_calls.evidence: Civil War: opening 1991 scene of Bucky intercepting the Starks' car; Tony's B.A.R.F. presentation recreating his last night with his parents; in Siberia Zemo shows footage revealing Barnes killed Howard and Maria, and Tony turns on Rogers and Barnes.
